meaning:
νομίζω
(νόμος), [in LXX: Wis.13:2 17:3, Sir.29:4, 1-28; 2Ma.4:1-50, 4Ma.8:1-29 * ;]
1. to practise, hold by custom: Act.16:13 (Rec., but see infr.).
2. to deem, consider, suppose: Mat.5:17 10:34 20:10, Luk.2:44 3:23, Act.7:25 8:20 14:19 16:13, 27 17:29 21:29, 1Co.7:26 7:36, 1Ti.6:5.†
SYN.: ἡγέομαι, q.v (AS)

elsewhere.note: “Don’t think that I came to destroy the law or the prophets. I didn’t come to destroy, but to fulfill.
but supposing him to be in the company, they went a day’s journey, and they looked for him among their relatives and acquaintances.
He supposed that his brothers understood that God, by his hand, was giving them deliverance; but they didn’t understand.
Therefore I think that because of the distress that is on us, that it’s good for a man to remain as he is.
constant friction of people of corrupt minds and destitute of the truth, who suppose that godliness is a means of gain. Withdraw yourself from such.
